name: Primary School
title: Primary tutoring for Wiltshire students
subtitle: KS1 and KS2 Maths and English tutoring
intro: Support foundational confidence, understanding and independent working habits before secondary school.
angle: We begin with what the child can already do and identify small achievable next steps. Practical, reassuring lessons help students see their own progress.

name: KS3
title: KS3 tutoring for Wiltshire students
subtitle: Year 7, Year 8 and Year 9 online tutors
intro: Bridge the move into secondary subjects and secure the knowledge needed for confident GCSE study.
angle: KS3 can be a valuable time to close small gaps before they become larger problems in Year 10.

name: SATs
title: SATs tutors for Wiltshire students
subtitle: Year 6 SATs Maths and English preparation
intro: Prepare for Key Stage 2 assessments with approachable, structured practice and a sensible revision plan.
angle: We teach the skills behind question types and help children practise calmly without turning every session into a test.

title: 11 Plus tutors for Wiltshire students
subtitle: 11+ entrance exam and grammar school preparation
intro: Build strong reasoning, English and Maths skills and practise unfamiliar question formats.
angle: Entrance assessment formats can vary between schools. We ask which school or assessment you are preparing for before planning lessons.

title: 13 Plus tutors for Wiltshire students
subtitle: 13+ common entrance and school entrance support
intro: Prepare for school-specific 13+ tests with individual subject support and exam practice.
angle: Our tutoring is tailored to the subjects and assessment style set by the target school; requirements are checked with the family.

name: GCSE
title: GCSE tutors for Wiltshire students
subtitle: GCSE Maths, English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and more
intro: Get focused GCSE subject support, targeted revision and exam-style practice for Year 10 and Year 11.
angle: We tailor lessons to AQA, Edexcel, OCR, Eduqas, WJEC and other specifications rather than giving every student the same worksheet.

name: IGCSE
title: IGCSE tutors for Wiltshire students
subtitle: International GCSE Maths, English and Science tutoring
intro: Prepare for Pearson Edexcel and Cambridge International IGCSEs with syllabus-matched teaching.
angle: We confirm the exact qualification and syllabus code before recommending suitable study materials.

name: A-Level
title: A-Level tutors for Wiltshire students
subtitle: A-Level Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English and more
intro: Develop deeper subject understanding and exam technique for Year 12 and Year 13.
angle: A-Level lessons focus on the depth, independence and precision expected at this stage, with tutors selected by subject and specification.

name: UCAT
title: UCAT tutors for Wiltshire students
subtitle: UCAT medical and dental admissions test preparation
intro: Build familiarity with the UCAT sections, efficient decision-making and timed test practice.
angle: UCAT content and scoring can change. We use the current official test specifications and practise strategies appropriate to the applicant.

name: TMUA
title: TMUA tutors for Wiltshire students
subtitle: TMUA mathematics admissions test preparation
intro: Practise mathematical reasoning, algebraic fluency and unfamiliar problems under timed conditions.
angle: A TMUA tutor helps students translate strong classroom Maths knowledge into fast, careful mathematical thinking.

name: University
title: University Maths tutors online
subtitle: University-level Maths and first-year quantitative support
intro: Get tailored help with demanding mathematical techniques and core university modules.
angle: Tell us the university module or topic and we can check specialist tutor availability.
